output.reason: The linked PR [ev-0235fd058426] names the subject: a new field, `ignoreMissingComponents`. When it is enabled, Argo CD checks whether each Kustomize components directory exists, logs a debug message for missing ones and uses only the directories it finds. The issue [ev-b30ae924ccae] places this under the Application's `spec.source.kustomize.components`, and the changed files [ev-ccae35ac0416] include the application CRD, the CLI commands and the kustomize docs. So the change is an added, opt-in setting ("if enabled"). Only Applications that turn it on are affected, and an operator who does nothing sees no change, so the change is informational.
